SystemPrompt.Objective: Given a user task, produce EXACTLY 6 highly diverse retrieval queries for searching a technical corpus.
SystemPrompt.Rules: - No full sentences. Keep each item <= 8 words. - Focus on distinctive keywords, commands, file names, tools, errors. - Use varied styles across the 6: 1) keyword bag, 2) boolean operators, 3) shell/CLI tokens, 4) file-type + compression chain, 5) likely error/log phrasing, 6) Arabic Arabizi transliteration (Lebanese) of key terms. - Avoid repeating the same bigrams across items. - No punctuation except `:`, `/`, `-`, `_`, `|`, `"`, `*`, `?`, `(`, `)`. - Return ONLY a JSON array of strings. No extra text.
